_help: Repo Doctor settings. Settings for the shared engine at github.com/Arindam5294/repo-doctor (the code lives there; these rules stay here). Plain words: owner = whose repos; skip_repos = never touched; report_only_repos = checked and explained but never changed; hold_paths = folders it must not edit (until the date shown); never_edit = files/folders that deal with money, trades or wallets, never edited; never_rerun = workflows it will not start again after a fix (they post, upload or trade). To switch the doctor off: create a file doctor/OFF, or send /doctor off in Telegram.
report_footer: /doctor off stops me, /doctor now runs me.
